'''Jason Chan Mind the Jedi Or Die''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Jason Chan]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14670">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14670 Mind the Jedi       Or Die], DeckTech (Jason "The Greatest" Chan, 18 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14670/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14670/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
